_file: .env.local — create it at the repo root; it's gitignored, so these never get committed
_help: Free: developer.spotify.com/dashboard → Create app → copy Client ID and Client Secret. Redirect URI doesn't matter (this uses the Client Credentials flow, no user login).
_why: Without these, the Music app's trending list, Terminal `play`, and Siri 'play X' all fail silently.
_warning: These are secrets. Put them in .env.local, not here — this file is just the reminder. Never paste them into a committed file.
